But effects are tiny: weight 0..1 moves centroid only 40 -> 35 Hz (40/40/38/37/35); length 0 -> 0.5 leaves decay at 5.86 s, only 6.15 and 6.91 s at 0.75/1; length=0 makes the output almost mono (correlation 1.00, width 0.04).
